title: R&M active patrol/security clients, wave 1 (real log data, forestry + council + orchard security) — from RemSec patrol log spreadsheets
provider_modules_basis: No new provider-level module enablement in this wave; access_control/patrol already enabled on R&M from the forestry_sector_rm_2026-09-16 seed.
notes: Every organization/site/zone here is backed by REAL R&M patrol-log spreadsheet data (RemSec - Documents/Patrol Log Entries/All Log Spreadsheets), not invented. Zone place-names were geocoded live via the app's own linz-lookup edge function (action: address_autocomplete, LINZ+Google) on 2026-09-22; a zone with no confident match is created UNPLACED (no geometry) rather than guessing coordinates, same convention as forestry-sector-rm.json.

PF Olsen Ltd already exists as a CRM prospect org from forestry-sector-rm.json (key 'pfo') — this file's org uses the SAME name 'PF Olsen Ltd' so the script's existing lower(name) match reuses that row (upgrades status to active, adds real sites/zones/agreement) instead of creating a duplicate.

Mainland Pest Control (MPC) log data is NOT a separate org here: its DATA sheet shows Company=TPFL for sampled rows, meaning it is pest-control activity performed on Tasman Pine Forests' own already-seeded land. Handled separately by attributing MPC log rows to TPFL's existing zones with a biosecurity tag, not by creating a new organization.

Wrattens, DART/OperationLizard, and OtherPrivate/PVT are deliberately NOT in this wave: Wrattens' raw comments contain an active third-party trespass dispute (names, phone numbers) needing the same locked-base-table treatment already used for firearm_licence_number; DART has precise NZTM2000 site-by-site coordinates needing its own conversion pass; PVT is a multi-person umbrella bucket needing a dedicated privacy-scoped design. See /memories/session/rm-full-population.md for the follow-up plan.
